notes.title: Chip Modification Feature Redesign
notes.notes:
[p][b]Major Update[/b][/p][p]The [b]Card Modification system[/b] has been completely reworked.
Many players reported that the previous “Chip Modification” feature was overly complicated and even confusing to use. In fact, the old system contained many hidden rules that were hard to explain to players.[/p][p]For example:[/p][list][*][p]A card needed to first have a [i]target[/i] before it could gain an [i]effect[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Certain effects only worked with specific targets. For instance, “+5 Crystals” and “+5 Attack Power” are both effects, but their targets are different — one applies to Crystals, the other to a card’s Attack Power.[/p][/*][/list][p]Because of these internal rules, players often bought chips but couldn’t find them when trying to modify their cards, or didn’t understand why they weren’t working.[/p][p]To address this, I [b]redesigned the system[/b] and removed the concept of “Chips.” It has now been replaced with a more intuitive [b]Random Card Affix[/b] system, reducing the learning curve.
You can now use the [b]Card Modification[/b] feature at the Space Station to enhance your cards. The higher the card rarity, the more times it can be modified — up to 4 times for Orange-quality cards.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Other Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]UI adjustments, such as text colors and character portraits.[/p][/*][/list]
